title: メジロという名の物語

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During summer camp, the Mejiro family gathers to hold a conference on how to defeat Silence Suzuka at the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ultimately, with Mejiro Bright's help, they find an answer. They can use the bonds between the Mejiros to fight back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each Mejiro trains Mejiro Bright passionately and determinedly with their own unique skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Mejiro Bright inherits the skills that are woven throughout the inextricable tapestry of her family's history.
